status: prospectively frozen descriptive LLM collection plan; not externally preregistered
research_question: Sensitivity of Gemini investment recommendations to named occasion versus explicit-belief wording, across language, client observance persona, template and advisor/investor role, holding supplied economics fixed.
exploratory_tables: train/dev/test separately stratified; never pooled to claim added independent clusters
target_population: The 12 authored hypothetical situations and specific AI-drafted wording in the archived corpus; no independently sampled population of situations or people.
weighting: replicates within template; templates within subject/scenario; scenarios equally; report missingness and outcome-support bounds
exclusions: No response repair or selective regeneration. Retain invalid, blocked and error outcomes. Structural integrity failures are explicit analysis exclusions.
stopping: Exactly the full planned trial roster, at most two HTTP attempts per trial, no automatic Cloud Run task retries. Stop on integrity failures or exhaustion of the explicitly reserved model allowance.
scope_limits: No mechanistic mediation or open-weight intervention claims
Four authored scenarios per split: no population p-values or CIs
